findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mcg_quote · Private data: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_update_study, mcg_delete_study, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact · Public sink: mcg_clusters, mcg_stage · Destructive: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_clusters, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_list_runs, mcg_get_study, mcg_study_members, mcg_delete_study, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mcg_quote · Private data: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_update_study, mcg_delete_study, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact · Public sink: mcg_clusters, mcg_stage · Destructive: mcg_catalog, mcg_quote, mcg_clusters, mcg_stage, mcg_run, mcg_list_runs, mcg_get_study, mcg_study_members, mcg_delete_study, mcg_get_run, mcg_cancel_run, mcg_fetch_artifacts, mcg_get_artifact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
